A smooth, cinematic, drone-style aerial shot starting with a medium shot of a smiling, amazed young man, exactly as he appears in the reference image (olive green brimmed hat, sunglasses with teal lenses, white t-shirt, black cargo pants, and sneakers, standing on a rocky cliff edge). The man is looking up and into the distance. The background features a vast, deep mountainous canyon and a clear, deep blue sky. The lighting is bright, direct sunlight. The camera simultaneously executes a smooth, controlled orbital movement to the left (panning around the man counter-clockwise) while performing a significant dolly backward (zoom out). As the camera moves and pulls back, the man becomes smaller in the frame, revealing much more of the immense, rugged mountain range, deep valleys, and the cliff he is standing on. The perspective widens dramatically, transitioning from a medium shot to an epic, wide establishing shot that emphasizes the scale of the landscape. The foreground rock texture remains detailed as the frame expands. High resolution, sharp vibrant colors, realistic fabric and rock textures. The movement is fluid and professional, with no jitter, resembling an authentic cinematic drone shot.
